title: Codex Can Drive the Simulator, but It Still Needs a Design Process
summary: Malte Hedderich reports that Codex can drive an iPhone Simulator, tap through flows, inspect screenshots, and rebuild when something breaks. His attempt at fully autonomous goal-driven construction was not good enough, so he returned to explicit specification, planning, task breakdown, and separate human-directed design work.
takeaway: Keep simulator operation automated, but split product work into specification, plan, tasks, and implementation. Provide approved wireframes and colors before asking the coding agent to build UI.
